# content language

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:contentLanguage`](gmeow-contentLanguage.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/contentLanguage>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The natural language of a work's content — the language a document, article, or page is written in. Distinct from the names slice's per-appellation language tag: this is the language of the BODY, not of a name. Non-functional: a multilingual work has several. Projects to [schema:inLanguage](https://schema.org/inLanguage) / [schema:iso6391Code](https://schema.org/iso6391Code) (the BCP-47 / ISO 639-1 code reconstructed from the [`gmeow:Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md)).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the natural language a work's body is written in — the language of the content itself; non-functional, so a multilingual work names several.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for the language of a single name or title (that is the names slice's per-appellation language tag) and avoid a bare BCP-47 string — point at a [`gmeow:Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md) individual.

### How to use

- Point the [`gmeow:Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md) at one or more [`gmeow:Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md) individuals via [`gmeow:contentLanguage`](gmeow-contentLanguage.md); the projection reconstructs [schema:inLanguage](https://schema.org/inLanguage) / iso6391Code from the language.
